title: In-product billing, upgrade prompts, locked notices, onboarding and Vera tell the ladder
detail: PHASE 6 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709). Billing settings (plan-ladder, go-business, billing-body), memberships section, payments body, components/pricing, components/upsell, feature-locked notice, Crew upgrade lightbox, onboarding personas, Vera create tools, the admin pricing console copy. Closed 2026-10-06: plan ladder names Collective, Business is where selling starts, the Crew upgrade page and lightbox sell the host kit instead of a fee, meter upsells drop the rate clause, and the Practitioner promise sells from Business.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const bad=[["app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/plan-ladder.tsx",/buys down that rate/],["app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/go-business.tsx",/buys down your rate/i],["app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/billing-body.tsx",/Collective toolkit/i],["app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/memberships/section.tsx",/stay open on every plan/i],["lib/spaces/memberships.ts",/stay open on every plan/i]].filter(([f,re])=>re.test(r(f))).map(([f])=>f);if(bad.length)fail("old model in product: "+bad.join(", "));console.log("ok: in-product copy tells the ladder")'
